title: Markers
subtitle: Southwest Division Men & Women Certified Markers

body: The men and women division Markers and club affiliations listed below were certified under the lead of our National Umpire in Chief, Melanie Vizenor. If your name should be on the list but isn't, let us know at the address below.

Markers received classroom and practical training to earn the title. In recognition of their willingness to participate, Markers were awarded shirts with a distinctive logo to be worn while performing their duties (see shirt and logo).

images.alt: A marker in a sun hat standing at the head of rink 11, watching the green beside the jack, with a red-and-blue rink scoreboard behind her
The Marker badge: a shield in red, white, blue and gold with the word MARKER above a large letter M

migrationNotes: The list of certified Markers is not page text — it is a published Google Sheet embedded in an iframe (gid=1306031354), carried across as an embed section. The names therefore still live in that sheet, not in this JSON.

Contacts to verify: Melanie Vizenor is named as National Umpire in Chief (a role that may have changed since the page was written, dated by image uploads from December 2020), and 'Become a Marker' emails mavizenor@gmail.com directly.
